title: 5-inch FPV drone frame
summary: carbon plates, lofted props, router check
description: A true-X freestyle quadcopter frame for 5 to 5.3 inch props, CNC routed from 2 mm and 5 mm carbon fibre sheet, with purple anodised standoffs, a 30.5 mm stack, a cage for a 19 mm camera and real 5.1 x 4.3 x 3 props lofted at their pitch.
process: CNC routing of carbon fibre sheet

difficulty.rationale: Lofted freeform props through table-driven sections on formula datum planes with washout and rounded tips, Steiner router proofs over four parts, a 45 deg datum layout, multi-body clearance and a centrifugal-stress check, kernel limits navigated.

standards: 30.5 x 30.5 mm M3 flight controller mounting
16 and 19 mm M3 motor bolt circles
materials: Carbon fibre (CFRP) sheet, 2 mm and 5 mm

prompt_test.result: Passed: check ok, 58 of 61 checks passing and 3 inactive by its design, check-range --deep at 11 points; wheelbase 225.6236 mm, motor holes 218.62 mm apart, standoffs 25 mm, frame 104.711 g, clearance 3.717 mm, stack holes 30.5 mm, slots 8.0 and 9.5 mm from the motor's centre, no overlaps, props 4.12 g with pointed tips, root stress 47.80 MPa, router bit proven on four outlines.
